name: Rowlett
seo_title: Rowlett, TX Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events
seo_description: Kids' Christmas in Rowlett, TX: the Holiday Main Street Fest and Parade of Lights, Christmas Trees on Main and Brunch at the North Pole at the library.
lede: The story of Christmas in Rowlett is told on Main Street, where the Holiday Main Street Fest and Parade of Lights fills downtown on December 5 and Christmas Trees on Main lines the street all December. The town grew from the Rowlett Creek land of Dr. Daniel Rowlett, who came to Texas in the 1830s, and the Katy railroad arrived in 1886.
sections: Holiday Main Street Fest and Parade of Lights

The City of Rowlett calls this its biggest holiday celebration of the year. It happens Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8:30 pm in Downtown Rowlett, 4000 Main Street. The city's event page lists a Parade of Lights, a giant Christmas tree, costumed characters, a holiday market of local artisans, live music on stage, glow experiences and a visit from Santa. Businesses, organizations and community groups were invited to decorate floats for the parade, according to the city's own social posts. The city posts maps, the schedule and the vendor list on its event page a few weeks before the night, so families can plan where to watch.
Christmas Trees on Main and Brunch at the North Pole

Christmas Trees on Main turns Downtown Rowlett into a month long walk, with trees sponsored and decorated by local businesses, community groups and families on display from December 1 to 31, 2026. Each tree is decorated differently, and the city lists the display as free to view. Inside, the Rowlett Public Library, 3900 Main Street, holds Brunch at the North Pole on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 11 am. The library's calendar lists it as a free event. Both are on Main Street.
The Katy line and the Blue Line

Rowlett's own railroad story starts in 1886, when the Missouri, Kansas and Texas line, known as the Katy, was built through the area, according to the Handbook of Texas. The community got a post office in 1889 and electricity in 1924, was incorporated in 1952 and boomed after Lake Ray Hubbard was completed in 1971. Today families arrive by light rail: DART opened its 4.5 mile Blue Line extension from Downtown Garland Station to Downtown Rowlett Station on December 3, 2012. For a bigger train day, the Interurban Railway Museum in Plano and the Museum of the American Railroad in Frisco each have a Rally page.

faq: The town grew from the Rowlett Creek land of Dr. Daniel Rowlett, who came to Texas in the 1830s. The Handbook of Texas says the Missouri, Kansas and Texas line, known as the Katy, was built through the area in 1886, and the community got a post office in 1889.
When did Rowlett become a city?

Rowlett got a post office in 1889 and electricity in 1924, and it was incorporated in 1952. The Handbook of Texas says it boomed after Lake Ray Hubbard was completed in 1971, which turned a small railroad community into one of the larger suburbs on the lake's shore.
What is the biggest Christmas event in Rowlett?

The City of Rowlett calls the Holiday Main Street Fest and Parade of Lights its biggest holiday celebration of the year. It is Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8:30 pm in Downtown Rowlett, 4000 Main Street, with a giant tree, a market, live music, glow experiences and a visit from Santa.
What can kids do at Christmas in Rowlett besides the parade?

Christmas Trees on Main fills Downtown Rowlett with trees decorated by local businesses, groups and families from December 1 to 31, 2026, and the city lists it as free to view. The Rowlett Public Library holds Brunch at the North Pole on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 11 am, listed as free.
Who organizes Christmas events in Rowlett?

The City of Rowlett runs the Holiday Main Street Fest and Parade through its Special Events Division, and it invited businesses, organizations and community groups to decorate floats. The Rowlett Public Library hosts Brunch at the North Pole. Both the parade and the library are on or near Main Street.
Can families take light rail to Rowlett?

Yes. DART opened its 4.5 mile Blue Line extension from Downtown Garland Station to Downtown Rowlett Station on December 3, 2012. Downtown Rowlett Station puts families near Main Street, where the parade, the Christmas Trees on Main display and the library are all located.
